## Names

<a id="note_freq_lo"></a>
### [`note_freq_lo`](../../../../src/music/note_frequencies.asm#L6) `$8184-$81C0`

*data*

Low bytes of the SID frequency of the notes 0-60, one semitone for each note. Note 0 is $0218: C-1 with the NTSC clock. The tunes use the notes 19-57.

- **Read by:** [`irq_handler`](../irq/interrupts.md#irq_handler) [`$8125`](../../../../src/irq/interrupts.asm#L99), [`irq_handler`](../irq/interrupts.md#irq_handler) [`$816C`](../../../../src/irq/interrupts.asm#L135)
